statement: A path pattern's cost is bounded: an `http:path:` pattern longer than 2,048 characters (an escape counting as the one character it writes, DOC-15), or with a segment that mixes `*`, `?` or `{name}` with other text in more than 16 parts (consecutive `*` counting once), does not compile, nor does a document whose patterns hold more than 2,048 glob units in all: the parts and literal characters of such segments, counted twice after a leading `**` or `{*name}` and for a rate limit rule keyed by a captured variable. A typed resource pattern is at most 2,058 characters.
guards: engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a pattern is at most 2048 characters
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a glob segment holds at most 16 tokens
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#consecutive stars in a segment count once
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a glob after a leading rest costs twice and is tried at two starts
engine:HttpPathPatternTest#a glob after a leading rest is decided at most twice
